decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Mega Gengar. Mega Gengar + Scarf Krookodile lead locks down targets with Shadow Tag; Scarf Krookodile outspeeds Scarf Hydreigon for a guaranteed 4x Close Combat KO while pressuring Gholdengo and Farigiraf. In the back, Hydrapple walling Mudsdale, Rotom-W, and Azumarill combined with Dragonite's Multiscale and priority cleanup handles any remaining endgame threats.

Farigiraf is immune to Gengar's Ghost STAB and carries Mental Herb to block Taunt. Mudsdale Protects turn 1 while Trick Room goes up, then sweeps with Body Press/Heavy Slam under TR. Gholdengo checks Hydrapple and blocks status with Good as Gold. Azumarill provides Fairy coverage for Dragonite and Krookodile.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Gengar alongside Hydrapple and Dragonite allowed Gengar to trap and burn Mudsdale while Hydrapple pressured Azumarill, setting up Dragonite to clean up with Extreme Speed once Farigiraf's Armor Tail was off the field.
reflections.adjustment: Prioritize removing Farigiraf early when bringing Dragonite so Extreme Speed is unlocked to pick off weakened threats before they can act under Trick Room.
reflections.notebook: Opponent relies on Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Mental Herb) to enable Trick Room and block priority, alongside a slow physical core of Mudsdale (Leftovers, Stamina) and Azumarill (Life Orb). Trapping with Mega Gengar's Shadow Tag and burning Mudsdale completely disarms their physical offense.

reflections.summary: Lost due to early critical hit from Dragonite's Earthquake on turn 4, which KO'd Gholdengo and crippled our offensive pressure. Dragonite's Multiscale and Lum Berry made it difficult to remove, and its Extreme Speed picked off weakened mons. Trick Room ended prematurely, and our team lacked answers to Dragonite's spread damage and Gengar's special attacks.
reflections.adjustment: Bring a different lead or Mega to handle Dragonite and Gengar. Consider Aerodactyl for Tailwind and Wide Guard to block Earthquake, or Arcanine for Intimidate and Will-O-Wisp. Protect Gholdengo better from spread moves, and prioritize breaking Multiscale before Dragonite acts. Alternatively, use a faster Trick Room setter or a redirector to control the pace.
